scripts.build: npm run generate && blume build && node scripts/headers.mjs
scripts.check: npm run generate && blume validate --strict && node scripts/translations.mjs
scripts.translate: node scripts/translations.mjs --ledger && npm run generate && { blume translate --claude $DOCS_TRANSLATE_ARGS; code=$?; node scripts/translations.mjs --prune && npm run generate && exit $code; }
